data.one_liner: An animated Text widget that counts between two numbers.
data.what_it_does: McCountingText is an animated Text widget that automatically counts between a specified begin and end number. It supports custom duration, curves, and decimal precision.
use_when: You need to animate numerical values changing inside a text widget.
You want to display countdowns or incrementing counters with smooth transitions.
avoid_when: You need complex data formatting not covered by standard numerical precision.
strengths: Supports custom duration, curve, and precision.
Allows counting up or down with positive and negative numbers.
